Array

Array

Available since version 8.0.

Collection elements:

Arbitrary
Iteration through collection using For each ... In ... Do operator is available to object.

Methods:

Add
Count

Constructors:

Based on a fixed array
By number of elements

Description:

This can be used to access array elements, array methods and the wizard.

Availability:

Thin client, web-client, mobile client, server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (client), mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.
Exchange with server is possible. Serializable.

Example:

Array = New Array(4);
Array.Add("String added");
Array.Add(123.45);

Available since:

Available since version 8.0.
